modifications: Proposed only, not promoted: uniform 0.72 scale in inspected Y-up meter coordinates.
Proper cyclic rotation to canonical Z-up, with original hinge on negative Y (right).
Separate connected parts into fixed frame/lower hinge barrels, moving panel/upper barrels, and handles. Preserve all visual components and handle collisions.
review_notes: dimensions_m measures the actual leaf (component 3), not projecting hinge hardware. Current normalizer measures the entire Panel group and cannot represent this distinction.
The original panel and frame have complementary rebates. A single convex panel hull fills its rebate; automatic convex decomposition also over-expands the frame.
The normalizer opening test assumes an aperture inset 1 mm from the full leaf bounds; the frame rebate makes this assumption unsuitable.
Hinge center is estimated from the matching cylindrical barrel bounds; it requires verification after collision preparation.
